instruction: Legacy Project Migration v5 to v9 You have a KiCad v5-era project in /home/user/Desktop/: /home/user/Desktop/legacy.pro (INI-style config), /home/user/Desktop/legacy.sch (EESchema v4 schematic), /home/user/Desktop/legacy.cache.lib (cached symbol library), and /home/user/Desktop/legacy.kicad_pcb (v4/v5 PCB). A migration mapping is provided in /home/user/Desktop/lib_map.csv (two columns: v5_lib_id, v9_lib_id). Migrate the project to KiCad 9 format. Produce four output files: 1. /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro - KiCad 9 JSON project file with top-level keys: meta (with version integer), net_settings, schematic, pcbnew. 2. /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_sch - KiCad 9 schematic (version 20231120) with all symbol lib_ids updated to v9 names per /home/user/Desktop/lib_map.csv. 3. /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb - KiCad 9 PCB (version 20240108) with updated layer names and footprint structure. 4. /home/user/Desktop/project.kicad_sym - Local symbol library (kicad_symbol_lib) freezing all 5 symbols from /home/user/Desktop/legacy.cache.lib in KiCad 9 format. Requirements: 1. All 4 files must exist under /home/user/Desktop/. 2. /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro must be valid JSON with meta.version (integer), net_settings, schematic, and pcbnew keys. 3. /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_sch must parse as s-expr and contain (version 20231120). 4. /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb must parse as s-expr and contain (version 20240108). 5. Every symbol in /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_sch must have a lib_id that appears in the v9_lib_id column of /home/user/Desktop/lib_map.csv. 6. The number of named nets in /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_sch must be >= the number in /home/user/Desktop/legacy.sch. 7. /home/user/Desktop/project.kicad_sym must contain >= 5 symbol definitions. 8. None of the 4 output files may contain the string 'EESchema' (v5 marker). Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro, /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_sch, /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb, /home/user/Desktop/project.kicad_sym. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
